About

profile

Mahesh Divakaran

Hi — I’m a Senior Technical Lead (Statistical Programming) and Clinical Data Scientist with close to a decade of experience in clinical data analysis, CDISC standards, and statistical programming. I currently work at Ephicacy Lifescience Analytics and am pursuing my PhD in Statistics at Amity University.

My work sits at the intersection of statistics, software engineering, and clinical research — building tools that help pharmaceutical teams analyze, visualize, and report clinical trial data with greater speed and accuracy.
